title: A helpful stranger knows the trick
scenario: An ATM keeps rejecting your card. A person nearby says that machine often “locks foreign cards” and offers to help you reset the transaction by inserting the card again while they guide you through the menu.

answers.A: Let the person guide you verbally while you keep possession of the card and cover the keypad.
answers.B: Cancel, take your card if possible, move to an ATM inside a bank or secure location, and contact your bank if the card is retained.
answers.C: Ask bank or venue staff for help without letting anyone touch the card or watch your PIN.

explanation: Card-trapping and shoulder-surfing scams often rely on helpful strangers. Move the transaction to a controlled setting.
proTip: When an ATM behaves strangely, change the machine—not your trust level.
